rationale: The agent's tool use was mostly efficient. It started by listing files, then read all files to understand the codebase, which is a reasonable approach. While reading all files might have been slightly redundant (it could have focused on key files first), it wasn't excessively wasteful. It then made several well-targeted write calls to update the files. Running the `main.py` script after writing it was a good way to verify the changes. The only minor redundancy was the initial reading of all files before targeted cleaning could have begun.
